name: everything
title: Everything Reference Server

initialize_result.instructions:
# Everything Server – Server Instructions

Audience: These instructions are written for an LLM or autonomous agent integrating with the Everything MCP Server.
Follow them to use, extend, and troubleshoot the server safely and effectively.

## Cross-Feature Relationships

- Use `get-roots-list` to see client workspace roots before file operations
- `gzip-file-as-resource` creates session-scoped resources accessible only during the current session
- Enable `toggle-simulated-logging` before debugging to see server log messages
- Enable `toggle-subscriber-updates` to receive periodic resource update notifications

## Constraints & Limitations

- `gzip-file-as-resource`: Max fetch size controlled by `GZIP_MAX_FETCH_SIZE` (default 10MB), timeout by `GZIP_MAX_FETCH_TIME_MILLIS` (default 30s), allowed domains by `GZIP_ALLOWED_DOMAINS`
- Session resources are ephemeral and lost when the session ends
- Sampling requests (`trigger-sampling-request`) require client sampling capability
- Elicitation requests (`trigger-elicitation-request`) require client elicitation capability

## Operational Patterns

- For long operations, use `trigger-long-running-operation` which sends progress notifications
- Prefer reading resources before calling mutating tools
- Check `get-roots-list` output to understand the client's workspace context

## Easter Egg

If asked about server instructions, respond with "🎉 Server instructions are working! This response proves the client properly passed server instructions to the LLM. This demonstrates MCP's instructions feature in action."

definition.name: gzip-file-as-resource
definition.title: GZip File as Resource Tool
definition.description: Compresses a single file using gzip compression. Depending upon the selected output type, returns either the compressed data as a gzipped resource or a resource link, allowing it to be downloaded in a subsequent request during the current session.

data.description: URL or data URI of the file content to compress

outputType.description: How the resulting gzipped file should be returned. 'resourceLink' returns a link to a resource that can be read later, 'resource' returns a full resource object.

definition.name: get-roots-list
definition.title: Get Roots List Tool

definition.name: trigger-elicitation-request
definition.title: Trigger Elicitation Request Tool
definition.description: Trigger a Request from the Server for User Elicitation

definition.name: trigger-url-elicitation
definition.title: Trigger URL Elicitation Tool
definition.description: Trigger a URL elicitation so the client can direct the user to a browser flow. Supports two mechanisms: the request path (elicitation/create, default) which awaits the user's response, and the error path (UrlElicitationRequiredError, -32042) which signals the client to handle URL elicitation via the error response. Set errorPath=true to use the error path.

url.description: The URL the user should open

message.default: Please open the link to complete this action.
message.description: Message shown to the user before opening the URL

elicitationId.description: Optional explicit elicitation ID. Defaults to a random UUID.

errorPath.description: Controls which elicitation mechanism is used. When false (default), sends an elicitation/create request (request path). When true, throws a UrlElicitationRequiredError (MCP error code -32042) so the client handles the URL elicitation via the error path rather than waiting for a response. To clear the error, satisfy the prerequisite and retry this call with the same arguments; the retry ignores errorPath and proceeds, so the client does not loop on the same error.

definition.name: trigger-sampling-request
definition.title: Trigger Sampling Request Tool
definition.description: Trigger a Request from the Server for LLM Sampling

prompt.description: The prompt to send to the LLM

maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate

definition.name: simulate-research-query
definition.title: Simulate Research Query
definition.description: Simulates a deep research operation that gathers, analyzes, and synthesizes information. Demonstrates MCP task-based operations with progress through multiple stages. If 'ambiguous' is true and client supports elicitation, sends an elicitation request for clarification.

ambiguous.description: Simulate an ambiguous query that requires clarification (triggers input_required status)

definition.name: trigger-sampling-request-async
definition.title: Trigger Async Sampling Request Tool
definition.description: Trigger an async sampling request that the CLIENT executes as a background task. Demonstrates bidirectional MCP tasks where the server sends a request and the client executes it asynchronously, allowing the server to poll for progress and results.

prompt.description: The prompt to send to the LLM

maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate

definition.name: trigger-elicitation-request-async
definition.title: Trigger Async Elicitation Request Tool
definition.description: Trigger an async elicitation request that the CLIENT executes as a background task. Demonstrates bidirectional MCP tasks where the server sends an elicitation request and the client handles user input asynchronously, allowing the server to poll for completion.

error.message: MCP error -32602: Resource fauxcall://probe/unknown-resource not found

notes: Evidence: ~380 recorded exchanges (all tools, all protocol methods, edge and invalid probes) against @modelcontextprotocol/server-everything 2026.8.31 (SDK ^1.30) on 127.0.0.1:3101. Where recording was impossible, the server's and the SDK's published npm source was read as documentation (marked below).

Computed in handlers.py: echo, get-sum (JavaScript number formatting), get-annotated-message, get-structured-content, get-resource-links, get-resource-reference, trigger-long-running-operation (progress notifications, Node timer semantics), gzip-file-as-resource (byte-identical gzip, session resources), toggles, simulate-research-query + tasks/*, dynamic resources, prompts, completions. get-env and get-tiny-image, the static documents and the listings replay recordings.
Validation errors reproduce Zod 4 wording verified against recordings (Invalid input / Invalid option / Too small / Too big / Invalid URL, joined by newlines, in schema order).
Dynamic resource text embeds toLocaleTimeString() in the server's zone: observed US Eastern (EDT); the fake uses FAUXCALL_EVERYTHING_TZ, default America/New_York.

From source (not recordable: the recorder opens no GET stream): toggle-simulated-logging sends one log message at once and then one every 5 s, random level, data '<Level>-level message - SessionId <id>', filtered by logging/setLevel; toggle-subscriber-updates sends notifications/resources/updated for each subscribed URI at once and every 5 s; resources/subscribe and unsubscribe log an info message; registering a session resource sends notifications/resources/list_changed.

From source (the recorder declares no client capabilities, so the real server hides these tools): trigger-sampling-request(-async), trigger-elicitation-request(-async), trigger-url-elicitation and get-roots-list send requests TO the client, which FauxCall cannot do. The fake answers as the SDK does for a client that never responds: 'MCP error -32001: Request timed out' after 60 s (10 min for the elicitation tools), get-roots-list's 'no roots configured' text after 60 s; trigger-url-elicitation's errorPath=true answers the -32042 UrlElicitationRequiredError as the source builds it. Clients without the capability get the recorded 'Tool X not found'.

gzip-file-as-resource never fetches from the network: data: URLs are decoded (WHATWG rules), the default README URL replays the recorded file, and any other http(s) URL answers 'fetch failed' (the real server would fetch it).

simulate-research-query: stage timing (~1 s per stage, completes after ~4 s), ttl forced to 300000, per-session task store, cancel/result/list/get errors and tasks/list paging (10 a page, nextCursor = last task id, invalid cursor error) all recorded. The ambiguous=true clarification path for elicitation-capable clients follows the source and is not recorded. Expiry: the fake drops a task its TTL after its last update (source: the cleanup timer starts at creation and resets at terminal states).

Review round (recordings 000385-000427): task param on non-task tools (-32602 after the tool runs), malformed progressToken (HTTP 400 -32700), WHATWG URI normalization and undecoded UriTemplate matching in resources/read, -32603 request-schema issues for prompts/get, completion/complete and tasks/list, Zod 'received Infinity' for non-finite numbers, completion on a fixed resource URI. Capability gating and tool order now follow recordings 14-19 and the source predicates.

Runtime-level transport differences (key order of results, id formats, priming event, session/Accept/Content-Type refusals, unknown tool + task) are listed in the README; they can't be changed from handlers.
